title: Entity history presentation
responsibility: Formats history verdicts, recorded timing comparisons, budget reviews and measurement changes.

inputs.name: historyListed.rows
inputs.description: Candidate history rows in their supplied order.

inputs.name: historyListed.read
inputs.description: Lookup of already-read revision details by commit.

inputs.name: entityHistory.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose benchmark series should be used.

inputs.name: entityHistory.rows
inputs.description: Listed commits in newest-first order; each compares only to the next listed commit in the same series.

inputs.name: historyProfiles.timings
inputs.description: Timing map whose profile identifiers should be collected.

inputs.name: reviewChanges.review
inputs.description: Budget review containing new limits and optional prior limits.

inputs.name: signedBytes.delta
inputs.description: Byte difference, or null/undefined when no comparison exists.

inputs.name: signedCount.delta
inputs.description: Count difference, or null/undefined when no comparison exists.

outputs.name: historyVerdict
outputs.description: Passed only for verified coverage; other labels distinguish verification failure, unusable evidence and missing evidence.

outputs.name: historyListed
outputs.description: Listed rows known to have changed the entity directly, been added or removed, plus a separate list of unknown rows whose details have not arrived.

outputs.name: entityHistory
outputs.description: Map of timings at listed commits, preserving workload, metric, target and profile. A before value is included only when that same series has a point at the next listed commit.

outputs.name: reviewChanges
outputs.description: One readable sentence per new limit, including the old-to-new change when a prior value exists. Emitted-size keys receive target labels.

outputs.name: signedBytes
outputs.description: Empty for a missing comparison, No change for zero, otherwise signed human-readable bytes.

outputs.name: signedCount
outputs.description: Empty for a missing comparison, No change for zero, otherwise a signed count.
